name: Piotr Müller - Après le § 63 - Am 15
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: 63d. Regrets that the strong requirement for a ‘link to the subject matter’ and the ban on references to ‘general corporate policies’ in procurement criteria has led to widespread legal uncertainty for, and litigation against, public authorities wishing to include strong social criteria, such as collective bargaining clauses, in tenders; considers this requirement to hamper the ability of contracting authorities to procure on the basis of their best interests;
